title: Hopalong Cassidy
paragraphs: William Boyd stars as Hopalong Cassidy, riding with California Carlson through western adventures involving outlaws, mysteries, and frontier justice.

Western adventure starring William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy and Andy Clyde as California Carlson. Frozen GRH set contains the 104 unique numbered Mutual/CBS network broadcasts from January 1, 1950 through March 15, 1952.

GRH documents the program through Mutual network (January 1, 1950 to September 24, 1950) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and CBS network (September 30, 1950 to March 15, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Clarence Mulford (creator on 6 recordings), Ted Bliss (director on 6 recordings), William Boyd (performer on 6 recordings), Albert Glaser (music director on 5 recordings), Walter White Jr. (producer on 5 recordings, director on 2 recordings, and transcriber on 1 recording), Andy Clyde (performer on 4 recordings), and Charles Beldon (performer on 1 recording and screenwriter on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include murder and violent crime, outlaws and bandits, frontier settlements and trails, gold, mines and treasure, and horses and riding.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Clarence E. Mulford literary origin, Transcribed syndicated radio launch, National network expansion, and Cross-media Hopalong Cassidy boom.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (6 shared credited people), [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]] (3 shared credited people), [[show|crime-classics|Crime Classics]] (2 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (2 shared credited people), and [[show|gunsmoke|Gunsmoke]] (3 shared credited people).
